artworks.title: Small Donkey at Berck (Un petit ane à Berck)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a donkey harnessed to a large cart or barge, positioned close to the viewer. The donkey and the vessel are seen in profile. The background shows a high horizon with a shaded area suggesting either water or sky. Fine lines and cross-hatching techniques are used to detail the donkey's fur and the cart's surface. The color scheme is monochromatic with cream tones and dark sepia-like lines. In the distance, the scene extends towards the horizon. The artwork portrays a simple yet detailed moment frozen in time.

artworks.title: La Flore de le Gros
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the waist up, facing slightly to her left. She has a calm expression and looks downward. She has delicate features and styled hair, possibly with a headpiece or flowers. She wears a flowing garment with additional fabric and foliage around her. In her right hand, she holds a floral object with leaves. The background features intricate etchings of foliage or a garden setting, contrasting with the woman's smooth figure.

artworks.title: Confidences
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: Two men are seen seated side by side, captured from the waist up. The man on the left leans slightly towards the other. His facial features are partially visible with dark hair that covers his forehead. He is dressed in a formal suit with visible buttons and appears to have something in his hand. The man on the right has a fuller face with a beard and mustache, and his hair is neatly styled. He appears to be wearing a coat over his shoulders. The background is textured with abstract shading and forms, suggesting an outdoor setting with undefined elements that add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Morphine Addicts (Morphinomanes)
artworks.description: The image shows parts of the upper bodies of two people. One person is positioned to the left and slightly foregrounded, while the other is in the background to the right. The person in the foreground is turned partially towards the viewer with their left shoulder visible. They have long hair and are wearing a garment with a high collar. The person in the background also has long hair and their facial features are less distinct. They appear to have a relaxed expression and are possibly resting their head on their hand. The background is heavily sketched with swirling lines and hatching.

artworks.title: La Biarrote
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, seated in a sideways position. She has dark hair, defined facial features, and is wearing a light-colored blouse with a textured pattern along with a darker skirt. The background is dark and textured with indistinct floral elements.

artworks.title: The Feathered Turban (Le turban à aigrette)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows the back of a nude person seated on a textured surface. They have a dark, medium-length hair obscuring part of their face, and their left arm is visible. The background is dark and undetailed.

artworks.title: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère of Tanjore)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dancer with a vibrant background. A person on the left is playing a stringed instrument. The dancer is in motion on the right, with fluid movement in the dress. The setting appears to be dimly lit with dense shadowing and dynamic textures. The composition highlights the contrast between the dance posture and the musician's presence. Fine detail and subtle tones create an engaging atmosphere, capturing the essence of music and dance.

artworks.title: La Muse Accoudée
artworks.medium: etching on JCA France laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a person's face and upper body, focusing mainly on the face. The person is resting their face on one hand, with fingers partially visible. The facial features are highlighted through the use of light and shadow, emphasizing the nose, eyes, and mouth. The hair is dark, contrasting with the skin. The person's clothing is not clearly seen, possibly dark in color, blending into the shadowy background. The background is textured with cross-hatching, creating depth. There's no visible jewelry or objects in the image. The overall artistic technique enhances the somber and introspective nature of the portrait.

artworks.title: Cardinal Mercier
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He is positioned facing slightly to the side, with a three-quarter profile view of his face. His facial features are detailed, with shadows emphasizing his brow, nose, and lips. The man's hair is receding with texture lines suggesting it is combed back. He is wearing a garment with a visible collar. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain and textured, focusing on the man's face.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man's head and shoulders with strong light and shadow contrast on his face, featuring a straight nose, a slightly downturned or neutral mouth, and stubble or a short beard. He wears a knit cap covering most of his head and a coat with a prominent collar. The background is plain, accentuating the etching lines on his face. The image is sketched in a linear style, giving a textured and dramatic effect.

artworks.title: A Family (Une famille)
artworks.description: The image features three individuals, portrayed from the shoulders up in layered positioning. The central figure faces right with long hair, the person above and slightly behind looks forward with short hair, and the person at the bottom has a head turned to the left. The background is textured with dark shading, suggesting a fourth face on the far right. There are no visible accessories, highlighting the faces and hair.

artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.description: The image is a close-up portrait showing the upper half of a person. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the side, with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has a deeply furrowed expression with prominent eyebrows and a thick beard. Their hair is covered by a large, draped fabric. The clothing appears loose and flowing, complementing the draped fabric around their head. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is dark and indistinct, drawing focus to the subject's face and upper body, creating a dramatic contrast with the lighting on the individual's features.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image shows a circular frame containing a complex arrangement of curved lines and shapes. At the center is a small winged figure wearing swirling garments, surrounded by birds, insects, and fruit. The design is both abstract and whimsical.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image shows a three-part scene. In the top segment, a figure runs to the right holding an object, with dogs and birds around. The middle section depicts still wildlife and trees. The bottom part shows an energetic chase. The artwork has a monochromatic palette with shades of brown and black on a tan background.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image features a triptych-like format with three horizontal scenes arranged vertically. In the upper portion, a figure is running with a birdcage followed by a dog, surrounded by branches and a perched owl. The middle scene shows a man harnessing a horse to a plow on tilled land, with sparse trees in the background. The bottom scene depicts a pig and two hounds in motion amidst robust trees. The artwork uses detailed etching techniques with black and beige tones, creating an antique look. The color palette is uniform throughout, giving a sense of cohesion to the narratives.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: Image description: A drawing featuring intricate designs with fantastical creatures and ornate details. In the center, there is an oval frame with the inscription "MATHIAS BEITLER" and the date "1612." Surrounding the central text are various decorations, including mythical creatures, vine-like lines, a sword-wielding creature at the top, a stylized staff at the bottom, shields with human faces on each side, and human-like figures holding sticks at the bottom corners. The design reflects symmetry and precision typical of heraldic or emblematic art from the late Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays a series of dark, silhouetted figures and objects arranged in three horizontal sections. The shapes suggest various dynamic poses and actions, resembling humans, animals, and trees with elongated limbs and geometric structures. In the top section, a figure is seen interacting with objects, similar to a craftsman with tools. The middle section features figures in motion, appearing as dancers or performers with exaggerated movements, possibly interacting with smaller animal-like shapes. The bottom section depicts figures in a hunt or chase scenario, with one figure holding a net or cage. The abstract nature of the silhouettes encourages imaginative interpretations of the actions and scenarios portrayed.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man (V.H. Reinnier)
artworks.description: The image shows a circular portrait of a person with curly hair, positioned in almost profile but looking directly at the viewer. The individual has a well-defined nose, full lips, and large eyes. They wear a detailed garment with visible folds and a high neckline. The portrait is intricately carved with fine lines for depth and detail. The background consists of closely spaced curved lines forming a solid dark backdrop, contrasting with the lighter tone of the person.

artworks.title: Youth Sleeping before an Altar
artworks.description: Classical figures in a mythological scene are depicted in a monochromatic style, likely using ink. The drawing features a circular composition. In the foreground, a reclining figure sits at the base of a large, rectangular pedestal, appearing contemplative. A tool is visible nearby, possibly a chisel. Above the reclining figure, a putto or cherub sits atop the pedestal next to a vase with flowers. To the right, another standing figure with flowing drapery gestures towards the vase. The round framing and meticulous crosshatching give the scene a classic aesthetic reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Woman with the Pear
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a woman behind a windowsill. She is leaning forward with her arms on the ledge. Her face is center, looking outward, with a gentle expression and soft facial features. Her hair is covered by a hood, likely part of a headscarf. She wears a dark, loose-fitting garment with voluminous sleeves and a low neckline, layered with other clothing. In her left hand, she holds a small purse by a string, and her right hand rests on a piece of fabric on the ledge. She wears a thin necklace and the background is dark, with a partly open wooden shutter beside her.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Officer
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in a three-quarter view. One arm is resting on a surface, and the other is not visible. The person has detailed facial features, a mustache, and long, wavy hair under a hat with a feather. They are dressed in historical clothing with high collars and decorative elements. The background has textured hatched lines.

artworks.title: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: chalk, pen and ink, brush and wash on sheet trimmed with gold paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man's portrait. He is facing forward with slight positioning to his right. The man has a beard and mustache, curly dark hair, and is wearing a hat with a broad brim. He has a neutral expression, wearing a coat with a fur collar over a light-colored ruffled shirt. The background is plain, focusing on the man within an arch frame, from the chest upwards, without prominently visible arms.

artworks.title: The Astrologer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.6 x 9.3 cm (4 15/16 x 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man with a long beard sitting at a table. He is in profile facing right, wearing a large hat and a voluminous robe. Objects on the table include a globe, an inkwell with a quill, and papers. The background features dark, arched lines suggesting a vaulted interior.

artworks.title: Lucas Cranach
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He has curly, medium-length dark hair and a beard. He is wearing a high-collared garment and his right hand is visible resting along the bottom edge of what appears to be a frame. The background features a pattern of fine cross-hatching. Below the portrait, there is an inscription with the name "LUCAS CRANACH," birth and death years, and a coat of arms with a bird atop a shield.
